jobs.title: Junior Technician (Lab)
jobs.description:
Applications are invited for recruitment to the post of Junior Technician (Lab) (BS-09) on regular basis at Federal Government Tuberculosis Centre, Rawalpindi against 6% Balochistan Quota.
No. of Posts: 01
Qualification:
Matric with Science.
One year Certificate/Diploma in relevant field from Medical Faculty affiliated with/recognized by University/Board.
Age Limit: 18–28 years, with 05 years general age relaxation plus 05 years additional age relaxation for candidates from Balochistan.
Only candidates having Balochistan domicile are eligible. Candidates already in Government Service must apply through proper channel and provide NOC.
Only shortlisted applicants will be called for walk-in-interview. Candidates must bring original documents along with two complete sets of attested photocopies and 04 fresh passport-size photographs at the time of interview.
No TA/DA shall be admissible for appearing in the walk-in-interview.
Interested/eligible candidates shall apply online through the National Job Portal (NJP) within fifteen (15) days of publication of this advertisement.
